questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Botanically, a pumpkin is a…
questions.q_zh: 从植物学上讲，南瓜属于……
questions.explain_en: Pumpkins grow from flowers and hold seeds, so they are fruits.
questions.explain_zh: 南瓜由花发育而来、有种子，所以是果实。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: What do plants need for photosynthesis?
questions.q_zh: 植物进行光合作用需要什么？
questions.explain_en: Plants use sunlight, water and CO₂ to make sugar and give off oxygen.
questions.explain_zh: 植物用阳光、水和二氧化碳制造糖分，放出氧气。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Which gas do plants give off during photosynthesis?
questions.q_zh: 光合作用时植物放出哪种气体？
questions.explain_en: Plants release oxygen, which we breathe.
questions.explain_zh: 植物放出氧气，正是我们呼吸需要的。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Which part of the plant takes in water from the soil?
questions.q_zh: 植物的哪个部分从土里吸水？
questions.explain_en: Roots soak up water and nutrients.

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Bees visiting pumpkin flowers help the plant by…
questions.q_zh: 蜜蜂飞到南瓜花上能帮植物……
questions.explain_en: Bees carry pollen between flowers so pumpkins can form.
questions.explain_zh: 蜜蜂在花之间传粉，南瓜才能结出来。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: You push a hay bale and it slides. What made it move?
questions.q_zh: 你推干草垛，它滑动了，是什么让它动？
questions.explain_en: Objects start moving when an unbalanced force acts on them.
questions.explain_zh: 物体受到不平衡的力才会开始运动。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Why does a jumping {name} always come back down?
questions.q_zh: {name} 跳起来为什么总会落回地面？
questions.explain_en: Earth's gravity pulls everything toward its centre.
questions.explain_zh: 地球的重力把一切往地心拉。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Running on rough dirt is easier to stop than on ice because of more…
questions.q_zh: 在粗糙土路上比在冰上更容易停下，因为……更大
questions.explain_en: Rough surfaces create more friction, which slows you down.
questions.explain_zh: 粗糙表面摩擦力大，能让你减速。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: A heavy pumpkin and a light pumpkin are pushed with the same force. Which speeds up more?
questions.q_zh: 用同样大的力推一个重南瓜和一个轻南瓜，哪个加速更快？
questions.explain_en: The same force accelerates a smaller mass more (Newton's second law).
questions.explain_zh: 同样的力，质量越小加速越快（牛顿第二定律）。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Which is a mixture you can separate with a sieve?
questions.q_zh: 下面哪种混合物能用筛子分开？
questions.explain_en: Pebbles stay in the sieve while sand falls through.
questions.explain_zh: 石子留在筛子里，沙子漏下去。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: How can you get salt back from salt water?
questions.q_zh: 怎样从盐水里把盐取回来？
questions.explain_en: When water evaporates, the salt is left behind.
questions.explain_zh: 水蒸发后，盐就留下来了。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Which tool separates iron nails from sawdust?
questions.q_zh: 哪种工具能把铁钉从木屑里分出来？
questions.explain_en: Iron is magnetic; sawdust is not.
questions.explain_zh: 铁会被磁铁吸住，木屑不会。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Sugar stirred into water seems to disappear. This mixture is called a…
questions.q_zh: 糖搅进水里好像不见了，这种混合物叫……
questions.explain_en: The sugar dissolves evenly, making a solution.

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
questions.q_zh: 哪颗行星离太阳最近？
questions.explain_en: Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun.

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Which is the largest planet in our solar system?
questions.q_zh: 太阳系最大的行星是哪颗？
questions.explain_en: Jupiter is bigger than all the other planets combined.
questions.explain_zh: 木星比其他行星加起来还大。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: How many planets are in our solar system?
questions.q_zh: 太阳系有几颗行星？
questions.explain_en: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune.
questions.explain_zh: 水金地火木土天海，一共 8 颗。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Why do we have day and night?
questions.q_zh: 为什么会有白天和黑夜？
questions.explain_en: Earth rotates once about every 24 hours.
questions.explain_zh: 地球大约每 24 小时自转一圈。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: How long does Earth take to go around the Sun once?
questions.q_zh: 地球绕太阳转一圈要多久？
questions.explain_en: One trip around the Sun is one year.

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Which body system carries oxygen around your body?
questions.q_zh: 哪个身体系统把氧气送到全身？
questions.explain_en: The heart pumps blood that carries oxygen.
questions.explain_zh: 心脏泵出的血液把氧气带到全身。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Which organ do you use to breathe in air?
questions.q_zh: 你用哪个器官吸进空气？
questions.explain_en: Lungs take in oxygen and let out carbon dioxide.
questions.explain_zh: 肺吸入氧气，呼出二氧化碳。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Which body system helps you move your legs to run?
questions.q_zh: 哪个身体系统让你的腿动起来跑步？
questions.explain_en: Muscles pull on bones to make you move.
questions.explain_zh: 肌肉拉动骨头，让你动起来。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Which body system sends messages from your brain to your feet?
questions.q_zh: 哪个系统把大脑的指令传到脚上？
questions.explain_en: Nerves carry signals from the brain to the body.
questions.explain_zh: 神经把大脑的信号传遍全身。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Where does digestion of your lunch mostly finish?
questions.q_zh: 午饭的消化主要在哪里完成？
questions.explain_en: Most nutrients are absorbed in the small intestine.
questions.explain_zh: 大部分营养在小肠被吸收。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Some tiny animals called tardigrades can survive in…
questions.q_zh: 一种叫水熊虫的小动物能在哪里活下来？
questions.explain_en: Tardigrades are famous for surviving extreme environments.
questions.explain_zh: 水熊虫以能在极端环境中生存而闻名。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Corn plants grow tall to reach more…
questions.q_zh: 玉米长得很高，是为了得到更多……
questions.explain_en: More sunlight means more photosynthesis.
questions.explain_zh: 阳光越多，光合作用越多。

questions.subject: farm
questions.q_en: Corn (maize) was first grown by people in…
questions.q_zh: 玉米最早是在哪里被人类种植的？
questions.explain_en: Indigenous peoples in Mexico domesticated corn thousands of years ago.
questions.explain_zh: 几千年前墨西哥原住民培育了玉米。

questions.subject: farm
questions.q_en: The silky threads on top of an ear of corn are called…
questions.q_zh: 玉米棒顶上那一缕缕的丝叫……
questions.explain_en: Each silk thread connects to one kernel.
questions.explain_zh: 每根玉米须连着一粒玉米粒。

questions.subject: farm
questions.q_en: In what season are pumpkins usually harvested in BC?
questions.q_zh: BC 省的南瓜通常在哪个季节收获？
questions.explain_en: Pumpkins ripen in September and October.

questions.subject: farm
questions.q_en: Which of these grows on a vine along the ground?
questions.q_zh: 下面哪种作物是藤蔓贴着地面长的？
questions.explain_en: Pumpkins grow on long vines that spread across the field.
questions.explain_zh: 南瓜长在铺满田地的长藤上。

questions.subject: farm
questions.q_en: Which farm animal says 'baa'?
questions.q_zh: 哪种农场动物会“咩”地叫？
questions.explain_en: Sheep say baa!

questions.subject: farm
questions.q_en: Hay bales are mostly made of…
questions.q_zh: 干草垛主要是用什么做的？
questions.explain_en: Farmers cut and dry grass to feed animals in winter.
questions.explain_zh: 农民把草割下晒干，冬天喂动物。

questions.subject: farm
questions.q_en: Pumpkins, cucumbers and melons are in the same plant family called…
questions.q_zh: 南瓜、黄瓜和甜瓜属于同一个植物家族，叫……
questions.explain_en: They all belong to the gourd family (Cucurbitaceae).

questions.subject: social
questions.q_en: Which province is Vancouver in?
questions.q_zh: 温哥华在哪个省？
questions.explain_en: Vancouver is in British Columbia.

questions.subject: social
questions.q_en: What is the capital city of Canada?
questions.q_zh: 加拿大的首都是哪里？
questions.explain_en: Ottawa is Canada's capital.

questions.subject: social
questions.q_en: What is the capital of British Columbia?
questions.q_zh: BC 省的省会是哪里？
questions.explain_en: Victoria, on Vancouver Island, is BC's capital.
questions.explain_zh: 维多利亚在温哥华岛上，是 BC 省省会。

questions.subject: social
questions.q_en: Which ocean is next to Vancouver?
questions.q_zh: 温哥华旁边是哪个大洋？
questions.explain_en: BC is on Canada's Pacific coast.
questions.explain_zh: BC 省在加拿大的太平洋沿岸。

questions.subject: social
questions.q_en: What leaf is on Canada's flag?
questions.q_zh: 加拿大国旗上是什么叶子？
questions.explain_en: The red maple leaf is Canada's symbol.
questions.explain_zh: 红枫叶是加拿大的象征。

questions.subject: social
questions.q_en: Buying food from local farms helps…
questions.q_zh: 买本地农场的食物有什么好处？
choices: Cut transport pollution and support farmers
questions.explain_en: Local food travels less and supports the community.
questions.explain_zh: 本地食物运输距离短，还支持社区。
choices_zh: 减少运输污染、支持农民

questions.subject: social
questions.q_en: The Fraser River flows into the ocean near which city?
questions.q_zh: 菲沙河在哪个城市附近流入大海？
questions.explain_en: The Fraser River reaches the Pacific south of Vancouver, between Richmond and Delta.
questions.explain_zh: 菲沙河在温哥华南边的列治文和三角洲之间入海。
choices_zh: 温哥华一带（列治文、三角洲）

questions.subject: social
questions.q_en: Which river valley east of Vancouver has lots of farms?
questions.q_zh: 温哥华东边哪个河谷有很多农场？
questions.explain_en: The Fraser Valley is one of BC's biggest farming regions.
questions.explain_zh: 菲沙河谷是 BC 省最重要的农业区之一。

questions.subject: social
questions.q_en: Canada has how many provinces?
questions.q_zh: 加拿大有几个省？
questions.explain_en: Canada has 10 provinces and 3 territories.
questions.explain_zh: 加拿大有 10 个省和 3 个地区。

questions.subject: capybara
questions.q_en: CAPYBARA! What kind of animal is a capybara?
questions.q_zh: CAPYBARA！水豚是哪类动物？
questions.explain_en: Capybaras are the largest rodents on Earth.
questions.explain_zh: 水豚是地球上最大的啮齿动物。
choices_zh: 世界上最大的啮齿动物

questions.subject: capybara
questions.q_en: Where do wild capybaras live?
questions.q_zh: 野生水豚生活在哪里？
questions.explain_en: They live near rivers and wetlands in South America.
questions.explain_zh: 它们生活在南美洲的河流和湿地附近。

questions.subject: capybara
questions.q_en: What do capybaras mostly eat?
questions.q_zh: 水豚主要吃什么？
questions.explain_en: Capybaras are herbivores.

questions.subject: capybara
questions.q_en: Capybaras are great at…
questions.q_zh: 水豚特别擅长……
questions.explain_en: They have slightly webbed feet.

questions.subject: capybara
questions.q_en: How long can a capybara hold its breath underwater?
questions.q_zh: 水豚在水下能憋气多久？
questions.explain_en: They can stay under for about five minutes to hide from predators.
questions.explain_zh: 它们能在水下待大约五分钟躲避天敌。

questions.subject: capybara
questions.q_en: Capybaras are famous for being…
questions.q_zh: 水豚以什么性格出名？
questions.explain_en: Other animals often sit right next to them.
questions.explain_zh: 其他动物常常挨着它们坐。

questions.subject: capybara
questions.q_en: Capybaras live in groups. About how many are in a typical group?
questions.q_zh: 水豚群居，一群通常大约有多少只？
questions.explain_en: Groups are usually around 10 to 20, sometimes more in the dry season.
questions.explain_zh: 一群通常十到二十只，旱季会聚得更多。

questions.subject: capybara
questions.q_en: Where are a capybara's eyes, ears and nose?
questions.q_zh: 水豚的眼睛、耳朵和鼻子长在哪里？
choices: High on top of its head
questions.explain_en: So it can see, hear and breathe while almost fully underwater, like a hippo.
questions.explain_zh: 这样几乎整个身子泡在水里时还能看、听和呼吸，跟河马一样。

questions.subject: capybara
questions.q_en: A capybara's front teeth…
questions.q_zh: 水豚的门牙……
questions.explain_en: Like all rodents, its front teeth keep growing, so it chews a lot to wear them down.
questions.explain_zh: 和所有啮齿动物一样，门牙一直长，所以要不停啃东西磨牙。

questions.subject: capybara
questions.q_en: Which of these is a capybara's relative?
questions.q_zh: 下面哪种动物是水豚的亲戚？
questions.explain_en: Capybaras and guinea pigs are both cavies.

questions.subject: capybara
questions.q_en: About how heavy is an adult capybara?
questions.q_zh: 成年水豚大约多重？
questions.explain_en: Adults usually weigh about 35 to 65 kg, roughly as much as an adult person.
questions.explain_zh: 成年水豚通常 35 到 65 公斤，差不多一个大人那么重。

questions.subject: capybara
questions.q_en: Capybaras usually rest during the hot day and eat more in the…
questions.q_zh: 水豚白天热的时候休息，多在什么时候吃东西？
questions.explain_en: They graze more in the cooler evening.
questions.explain_zh: 它们在凉快的傍晚多出来吃草。

questions.subject: capybara
questions.q_en: Why do capybaras love to sit in water or mud?
questions.q_zh: 水豚为什么爱泡在水里或泥里？
choices: To stay cool and protect their skin
questions.explain_en: Water and mud keep them cool and protect against sun and insects.
questions.explain_zh: 水和泥能降温，还能防晒防虫。

questions.subject: capybara
questions.q_en: The name 'capybara' comes from an Indigenous South American language. It roughly means…
questions.q_zh: “capybara”这个名字来自南美原住民语言，大意是……
questions.explain_en: It comes from the Tupi language and is often translated as 'grass eater'.
questions.explain_zh: 名字来自图皮语，常被译作“吃草的家伙”。

maze_rule: Every corn_maze question has 2 or 3 choices. Show choice 0/1/2 on signs over the LEFT/MIDDLE/RIGHT path at a real fork; running into the correct path continues forward, a wrong path is a short dead-end loop that leads back. No question text says 'turn left/right' anymore.
sign_rule: Maze signs show sign_en (top) and sign_zh (below); full text stays in the top bar.
